about.text: similar to the Pera cheese. The cheese is made with rich in fat milk. In the process it is heated and stretched in a technique called "pasta hilada" creating threads that make layers called "cueros" which give the siete cueros cheese its characteristical texture.

sources.text: variety of queso pera: unripened stretched curd, semi-soft, often unpasteurised cow milk, stretched in water or brine above 70 C
